subject: Mutual close plan: constrained test-basket handoff & retention
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual close plan: constrained test-basket handoff & retention

Claire —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our alignment on scope, attached is a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures: the limited test-basket BrightCart will share, the acceptance window, and our requested retention / destruction controls. Highlights: 

- What we need from BrightCart: a scoped CSV inventory of the test-basket (sample IDs + short descriptions) and confirmation that samples are non-production PII.
- What Redwood will provide: ephemeral sandbox access to run the probe suite, 14-day vapor window for results, and a takedown/erase attestation after closure.
- Usage constraints: asset access limited to the pilot team (max 8 seats), no retention beyond 30 days post-acceptance unless explicitly permitted by BrightCart legal.
- Escrow / escrow-like custody: we propose a short-term encrypted staging bucket and automatic key rotation on handback.

I've attached: BrightCart_MAP_draft_v3.pdf (MAP with milestones), test-basket-inventory.csv (template), and redwood-usage-gates.md (brief ops notes).

Proposed close timeline (high level):
1) Oct 4 — BrightCart returns completed inventory + legal checklist
2) Oct 6–16 — Redwood runs probe suite in ephemeral sandbox
3) Oct 20 — Acceptance meeting and sign-off (if all pass)
4) Oct 21–25 — Handback and destruction attestation

Could you confirm whether the retention window and the 30‑day no-retain constraint are acceptable to legal? Once we have inventory + legal OK we will schedule the sandbox access.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: BrightCart_MAP_draft_v3.pdf (PDF), test-basket-inventory.csv (CSV template), redwood-usage-gates.md (MD)]

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@brightcart.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BrightCart Legal <legal@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual close plan: constrained test-basket handoff & retention

Markus —

Appreciate the clear plan and the templates. A couple of quick notes from our side after an initial legal check: 

- Inventory: we'll fill the CSV but need to mark a subset of the basket as "sensitive (masked)" — legal wants explicit confirmation that Redwood will not attempt re-identification or enrichment.
- Retention: 30 days works for engineering, but legal has asked whether a 7-day sandbox TTL (data auto-delete) with a 30-day attestation window is possible. Their ask is to limit active storage to 7 days and keep only attestations/metadata for 30 days.
- Access seats: can you confirm role-based access? They'd like a single named reviewer + two engineers rather than a generic seat pool.

Also attaching a short legal checklist (coming separately). Before we sign off we will need a brief clause in the MAP: "No re-identification; limited technical access; attestation on deletion."

If we can accept the 7-day TTL + 30-day attestation workflow, we'll move the inventory to you by EOD Monday Oct 4.

Best,
Claire
Sr. Product Manager, BrightCart

[Attachments: BrightCart_legal_checklist.pdf (PDF) — incoming]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual close plan: constrained test-basket handoff & retention

Quick internal note — per Claire's ask: we can support a 7-day active TTL with logging and a 30-day attestations record. Operational implications and commercial ask:

- Engineering effort to enforce TTL + per-file attestations: low (we have the automation), but we should log this as a conditional for the pilot at no extra charge.
- Seats: we'll allocate a named reviewer + two engineers as requested (will lock identities once BrightCart provides names).
- Pricing/credits: recommend offering the pilot as a complementary 2-week sandbox trial under the current PO to remove friction; if BrightCart asks for longer retention later we can surface pricing.

Action items for Monday (Oct 4):
- Confirm inventory received from BrightCart (Markus)
- Prep ephemeral sandbox (Lauren)
- Prepare brief clause language for MAP to cover non-reid + TTL + attestation (Ben)

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual close plan: constrained test-basket handoff & retention

Claire —

Thanks — that flow looks good and we can accommodate the 7-day TTL with a 30-day attestation ledger. Attached here is an updated MAP (v3.1) with the clause language and the exact ops steps for the TTL and attestations. Key updates: 

- Clause: "Redwood Inference will not perform re-identification or enrichment on any dataset provided under this MAP. Data provided will be stored only in an ephemeral staging bucket and will be programmatically deleted 7 days after ingestion. Metadata and deletion attestations will be retained for 30 days for audit purposes only."
- Seats: please send the named reviewer + two engineer emails and we'll add to RBAC.
- Timeline: If inventory arrives EOD Mon (Oct 4) we will start provisioning Oct 6 and aim to complete probe runs by Oct 16.

Next steps / asks: 
1) Claire: confirm inventory delivery and send named reviewers
2) BrightCart Legal: confirm the clause copy or suggest edits
3) Ben / Lauren: prep the sandbox link and DocuSign MAP route — I'll send the DocuSign link once legal confirms.

Link to updated MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAP_draft (BrightCart_MAP_draft_v3.1)
DocuSign (for signature once legal clears): https://app.docusign.com/BR-2026-1134

Thanks everyone — aiming to keep this low-friction.

— Markus
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: BrightCart_MAP_draft_v3.1.pdf (PDF), test-basket-inventory.csv (populated template expected), redwood-usage-gates.md (MD)]
